name: Delete confirmation (historical)
summary: Kept only because the Try it still runs on it. The frame it records was deleted from the file, and the flow it draws — a detail sheet over the home — has been replaced by a Memory details page. Confirming deletion, with an optional second action: also delete the chat the memory started in.

looseEnds.title: Deleting a memory can also delete a conversation
looseEnds.detail: The dialog offers 'Also delete the chat where the memory started', defaulted off, with the clarifier 'The chat stays in your chat history unless you check the box.' That couples Memory Management to Chat History destructively: one checkbox removes a conversation the user may want for other reasons.
looseEnds.ask: Confirm the coupling is intended, whether it is recoverable, and what happens to other memories derived from that same chat.

looseEnds.title: Sheet behind the dialog uses different copy again
looseEnds.detail: Visible behind the scrim: 'Memory details', category 'Vaccines', provenance 'Created last month from a conversation' — all three differing from the detail-sheet frame.
looseEnds.ask: Same decision as on the detail sheet.

looseEnds.title: No confirmation or undo after deleting
looseEnds.detail: Nothing shows what the user sees once Delete is pressed — whether the sheet dismisses to the list, whether a toast confirms, or whether the action can be undone.
looseEnds.ask: Deletion is irreversible as drawn. Is undo expected?
